info.description: Multi-tenant operational API with RBAC, customers, sites, work orders, audit/activity, attachments, notifications, webhooks and deterministic operational risk/daily brief views. A server-owned client contract keeps web, Android and iOS behavior aligned. AI contact-center routes are tenant-scoped and remain disabled until encryption and provider configuration are supplied. Language catalog rows are planned, not production-qualified; PSTN/SIP adapters are not connected.
info.title: OpsCore Operational SaaS Starter API
